messages:
jordan: Thanks for the All-Hands — quick thread for follow-ups on KMS / VPC / audit logs / SOC2. TL;DR: a few concrete asks from product teams.

jordan: 1) Audit log retention per-region? do hosted customers get 90d by default? Can we export raw events to customer S3?

jordan: 2) BYOK/KMS: what's in-scope for BYOK vs Redwood-managed keys? Rotation policy and who can request key deletion?

jordan: 3) SOC2/ISO evidence: where's the canonical deck + timeline for completing ISO mapping?

jordan: 4) VPC/PrivateLink: can Dedicated customers peer with their other clouds or is Private only VPC peering inside Redwood infra?

maria: Great questions — answering succinctly, see details below. Will follow up with a short doc and owners.

maria: Audit logs: hosted customers get 90 days raw by default in our central logging tier; compressed/aggregated logs kept 365d. We support export to customer-managed S3 for Dedicated & Private (not for free-tier hosted). Export mechanism: push-based export via our log-export job.

kevin: For the export, example config:
```
log_export:
  destination: s3://acme-redwood-logs
  format: jsonl
  retention_policy: raw-90d
```
We also provide an AWS Kinesis/CloudWatch forwarder for enterprise partners.

maria: BYOK scope: Private deployments (VPC & on-prem) can use customer keys (BYOK) with HSM/KMS integration. Dedicated customers can opt into BYOK for data-at-rest via a managed key you provide; hosted customers use Redwood-managed keys by default.

maria: Rotation: we rotate keys quarterly for Redwood-managed keys; BYOK rotation cadence is customer-controlled, but we require a 30-day key overlap window for safe rollover.

sasha: From Legal: key deletion requests require a signed request + verification call for BYOK. For SOC2 evidence we need the signed ALA (access and logging agreement) to show chain of custody for keys/log exports.

lia: For SOC2 & ISO artifacts — where do teams grab evidence? I couldn't find the latest SOC2 evidence bundle path.

maria: SOC2 evidence pack is at https://redwood.company/security/evidence/soc2-2025.zip (read-only link for internal use). ISO mapping: we're on a 6-week plan to map controls; PMR owning that is me + @kevin. Target: draft mapping by next All-Hands.

kevin: On VPC: Private provides private control plane & customer KMS integration. Dedicated supports VPC peering + PrivateLink depending on customer reqs. Short rule: Private = customer-managed network; Dedicated = isolated infra but peering is possible with approval.

jordan: thanks. Two follow-ups: (a) can hosted customers request log exports for eDiscovery? (b) is there a public API for requesting key rotation/deletion events?

maria: (a) Hosted: we can provide ad-hoc export for legal/DSAR under a support contract; it's not self-serve today. (b) We expose key lifecycle events to the console and a webhook for Dedicated/Private customers. No public REST endpoint for hosted keys.

audit-bot: Created ticket #SEC-8412 to track "Hosted eDiscovery export self-serve feasibility" assigned to maria. Estimated ETA: investigation by 2 weeks.

kevin: Action items: I'll add a step-by-step doc for S3 export + sample Terraform for RBAC. Will post in #eng-docs by EOD tomorrow.

sasha: I'll prep the ALA template and post to the legal drive; ping me if you need example clauses.

jordan: Awesome — can we get a single one-page FAQ for PMs that we can link from product PRDs? If yes, please drop link in this thread.

maria: Yes. I'll draft a one-pager and upload to /security/comms/one-pagers/within 3 business days. Will loop @jordan and @kevin for review. :thumbsup:

lia: +1 — that'll help a ton.

jordan: Thanks all. If anyone else has questions, add them here or ping me. Closing thread for now but will update when docs land.
